title: 苦手なもの
restoration: 原画の切り出し・規格内の紙色補正（拡大・反転なし）

tasks.script: LEFT ①: in Ryuji's imposing yakuza-office shop, Hajime politely tells Ryuji 「ミント、苦手で。」 Ryuji calmly notes it in an ordinary order pad. RIGHT ②: wildly overblown security checkpoint across the same office; two stern adult suited guards gently escort a tiny PERSONIFIED WALKING MINT SPRIG out through a barrier, its leaves drooping. Large sign 「ミント出禁」. Ryuji in WHITE CHECK SUIT stamps a tiny order memo with solemn authority saying 「徹底する。」 Hajime boggles and asks 「国家？」 No violence, it is absurd hospitality.
